pathAssistantSteps.info: Ensure all deal details, approvals, and documentation are accurate and complete for booking.
Confirm successful closure, reinforce customer confidence, and ensure readiness for onboarding or value realization.
Finalize commercial terms, resolve objections, and reach alignment with all stakeholders to secure deal commitment.
Focus on clearly validating the customer’s problem, confirming basic qualification (budget, stakeholders, timeline), and ensuring there is mutual interest to move forward.
Prepare for delivery by confirming handoff readiness, implementation details, and internal alignment.
Collaborate internally to design a feasible solution, align on pricing, and ensure the customer is ready to review a formal proposal.
